sloka: उद्गात्रे च तथा उदीचीम् दक्षिणैएषा विनिर्मिता ।अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे स्वयंभु विहिते पुरा ॥१-१४-४४॥
transliteration: udgātre ca tathā udīcīm dakṣiṇaieṣā vinirmitā ।aśvamedhe mahāyajñe svayaṁbhu vihite purā ॥1-14-44॥

translations.english: But all the priests said to the king purged of his sins, "O Lord of men you alone are capable of protecting this earth".
